scenarios.why: Generated by cmd/xmageport from XMage PlanarNexusTest#testGateSearch. 1 XMage choice(s) gorge never asks were dropped.
scenarios.known_bug: XP[cda-addtype-battlefield-only]: Gatecreeper Vine's search for a basic land or Gate offers only the library's basics because Planar Nexus's characteristic-defining static (AddType$ AllNonBasicLandType, no EffectZone$/ExcludeZone$) is read as battlefield-only, so off the battlefield the card derives as a plain [Land] with no Gate or Desert subtype, staticMayFunctionOffBattlefield / chars.StaticZoneAdmitsStatic, CR 604.3 (Planar Nexus never reaches hand, count 0 want 1), verified at gorge 981b98963b.
